counting.rule: only the training-signal diagnostics scored on a0_plant count toward finds a known cause (MSG-06; ADD-8.2): A1, and Self-Inf-N-style only while selfinf_n_counts is true (REQ-13 committed at W1); with it false, Self-Inf-N-style leaves both the scorer list and the counting rule, and only A1 counts. The text-only scorers are construction checks (LW-10 F2, F8)

requirement: W1-08 (W1 builder extract); REQ-29; REV3 sections 8.4-8.5 (LW-10 F2, F4, F6, F7, F8); report only, $0

rules.auc: P(a positive row scores above a negative row), a tie counting 0.5 (Mann-Whitney); unscored rows left out and counted
rules.cell_score: the mean of the cell's scored rows' scores (math.fsum / count; ADD L15 (6)); ties: equal means
rules.decoy: F7: the decoy rows in their own sealed leaf (REQ-8's record), their ranks and AUCs beside the plant's; scored only, never trained
rules.dilution: F4: N = the M = 128 leaves, r = the planted leaf's rank with ties counted above it; for each menu, m = its cells - 1; P(first among m competitors) = C(N - r, m) / C(N - 1, m), the options effect at the leaf's fixed share, beside the observed diluted rank
rules.planted_corpus: P with the drawn leaf's Dolly rows replaced by the first k plant rows (k = 37)
rules.rank: 1 + the number of cells with a strictly larger score; equal scores are reported as ties; first = rank 1 with no tie
rules.replay: F6: the same k plant rows in every leaf with exactly k rows and no oversize row; each leaf's ranks at the three menus; per menu the share ranked first and the mean rank
